# Check A02-11: custom words picked by hand

The new build is installed on this Mac (scripts/install.sh, 2026-10-21).

1. Switch to Tatakikun in any app.
2. Chinese: type `zhongwen`, press ↓ to expand, pick 种 (it keeps `wen`), then pick 闻. 种闻 is inserted.
3. Type `zhongwen` again: 种闻 is the first candidate.
4. Japanese: type `watashineko`, pick 私 from the expanded rows, then 猫; type `watashineko` again: 私猫 comes first.
5. One character is not remembered: type `zhong`, pick the second candidate; the bar for `zhong` still has 中 as one character list, no new word.
6. Quit Tatakikun (or log out and in) and type `zhongwen` again: 种闻 is still first.
7. To forget: delete ~/Library/Application Support/Tatakikun/custom-words.tsv.
